item.text: The existing inline renderer handles code spans and links, but emphasis is only two regex substitutions, so it cannot satisfy nesting, flanking, or modulo-three rules. I’m replacing that narrow stage with a delimiter-run matcher while preserving the existing higher-precedence protected inline elements.
